title: Titanic Souvenir
html:
Quest Giver: Okon

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Clobber Titantic Tom in Level 2 of MutantMania. Bring a souvenir back to Okon in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Okon

Repeatable: No

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Clobber Titantic Tom in Level 2 of MutantMania. Bring a souvenir back to Okon in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Ooo! Ooo! Over here! I jutht heard the retired Titanic Tom ith hiding on Level 2 of the MutantMania dungeon! I'm thure you've heard of him. He wath the big guy that broke a guy'th leg at the famouth Semi-Pro/All-Action fight like twenty yearth ago. He ith kinda washed up now, but there ith thtill a market for hith collectables.

You are looking ethpethially tough today! I bet you can run down there and clobber Titanic Tom and get me a thouvenir! Knock hith jock off!!!

Turn-in:

Thankth you tho much! Thith will be perfect for my new dithplay cathe.

Objectives:

  • Clobber Titanic Tom
  • Titanic Tom's Jock Strap ×1

Level range: 82–100
